name: Hantu Bungkus
description: Hantu Bungkus (Malay 'wrapped ghost'), known in Indonesian as Pocong, is the restless spirit of a deceased Muslim whose burial shroud (kain kafan) was not properly untied at burial. It is depicted as a body still wrapped in white cloth that hops or floats at night.

aliases.name: Kafan ghost
aliases.meaning: After kain kafan, the Islamic burial shroud

origin: Predominantly the Malay-Indonesian Muslim cultural sphere: Indonesia, Malaysia, Brunei, Singapore, southern Thailand, and the Malay diaspora.
